propositions: The resolved_statuses config keys (jira.resolved_statuses and reconciler.resolved_statuses) became inert after task f020 deleted the inbound absence-probe port that was their sole consumer
Both keys must continue to load and validate identically while emitting a deprecation warning naming removal in v1.0.0, rather than being hard-removed immediately
The write-only DC transport plumbing (resolved_statuses parameter, _resolved_statuses attribute, DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES constant) must be removed since no code consumes the stored value
Schema fields must be marked with read-via pointers to the follow-up hard-removal ticket, and config-read gate tests must pin the new marker set
Documentation must describe both keys as deprecated, warn-class, and scheduled for removal, fixing the pre-existing inconsistency about which component owns the inert story
